sectionTitle: Full-spectrum solutions for venture private capital markets.

services.title: Private Markets Concierge
services.description: Off-market access to the next generation of winners. Our Silicon Valley relationships: VCs, founders, growth funds create exclusive deal flow for buyers and sellers alike. Market pricing, institutional process, discreet execution.

services.title: Venture Secondaries Advisory
services.description: Turning illiquid venture positions into successful exits. We execute all transaction types (tender offers, direct sales, and hybrid rounds) delivering tailored liquidity solutions. Full advisory from secondary valuation through closing, including deal structuring, marketing materials and roadshows.

services.title: GP-Led Advisory
services.description: Institutional-grade solutions for venture and growth GPs optimizing DPI metrics. We structure continuation vehicles, strip sales, and fund recapitalizations.

services.title: LP-Led Advisory
services.description: Institutional-grade exit execution for LPs in VC positions. Whether rebalancing, managing overallocation, or liquidating mature positions, we deliver superior outcomes through competitive processes.

services.title: Valuation & Analytics
services.description: Independent valuations using the latest methodologies fitted to business specifics. We also build waterfall models for multiple scenarios: previewing secondary deal proceeds, calculating next-round dilution, stress-testing downround impacts, and tracking portfolio NAV changes.

services.title: Liquidity Partners
services.description: Direct connections to the buyers that matter: top-tier secondary funds, sovereign wealth, and family officess. We don't mass-market, we orchestrate selective introductions to pre-qualified counterparties actively deploying capital.

services.title: The secondr Platform (Coming Soon)
services.description: Proprietary technology to accelerate every aspect of secondary transactions. From AI-powered buyer matching to automated document processing, we're building the infrastructure for tomorrow's private markets.
